scientific_integrity: Claims, proof, limitations and reproducible checks correspond to one all-level integrality theorem and its explicit nondivisibility witness. No external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to the specified signed, two-parameter cyclotomic recurrence family; not to all order-two recurrences. Prior base-level and divisibility criteria are credited; absence of an implicit pre-existing all-level formulation is not independently certified. The included finite checker corroborates, but does not replace, the universal proof.
title: An all-level binomid nondivisibility family of cyclotomic recurrences
